int_name: N BROAD ST & W CUMBERLAND ST

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with multiple lanes, creating a long crossing distance for pedestrians. While sidewalks and marked crosswalks are present, the markings are significantly faded and the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian safety enhancements like refuge islands or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, making the pedestrian crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the side street and main road

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway crossing from left to right

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction
hazards.description: A black vehicle is parked across the sidewalk area, forcing pedestrians to deviate from their path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the commercial building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint crosswalks with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with a high-visibility crosswalk on one leg and standard traffic signals. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the path of vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main multi-lane road

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide clear crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide one-way roadway with a traffic signal and curb ramps, but lacks marked crosswalks and visible pedestrian signal heads. This configuration creates a high-exposure environment where pedestrians must cross multiple lanes without designated markings or dedicated signal phases.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalk markings at this signalized intersection, reducing driver awareness of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane one-way street increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic during a crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: The width of Cumberland St

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a paved sidewalk that is significantly obstructed by utility poles and lacks ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to navigate an unmarked roadway with potential sightline obstructions from utility infrastructure and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated in the middle of the sidewalk, narrowing the accessible path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb without a ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection in the foreground.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks to designate a safe crossing area, reducing driver awareness of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection roadway.

interventions.title: Install ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct tactile, sloped curb ramps at the intersection corners to ensure universal accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver yielding.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening or Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or relocate utility poles to provide a continuous, unobstructed clear path of at least 5 feet.
